title: Understanding Replication
text: Think about what 4-way replication means. If each fragment is stored on $$4$$ different machines, how many copies of each fragment do you have?

title: Calculating Failures
text: Consider how many copies of each fragment you need to access the entire file. If you have $$4$$ copies of each fragment, how many can you afford to lose and still have at least one copy left?

title: Maximum Failures
text: If each fragment is stored on $$4$$ machines, how many machines can fail while still ensuring at least one copy of each fragment is available?
